decisive_items: using serial doses of nonionic iodinated contrast (Iopromide) totaling 3 mL/kg over 30 minutes
approximately 12 hours after the procedure, the patient developed clonic movements of the left upper limb and persistent sucking motions
slight diffuse increase in cortical density predominantly in the right frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes
response.rationale: Temporal link to contrast administration, focal seizures, and non-hemorrhagic diffuse cortical hyperdensity on CT strongly favor contrast-induced encephalopathy. Hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy is less specific given the imaging pattern and absence of acute hypoxic injury features on CT.

rejected.why: Hypoxia/arrest occurred intraoperatively, but imaging shows diffuse cortical hyperdensity without edema/infarct pattern typical of HIE; the contrast timing and dose are more decisive.
